rawContent:
This is why our movements MUST be intersectional

#MeToo and #BelieveSurvivors must include #DefundThePolice and vice versa

When your goal is restorative justice, these movement are not mutually exclusive or in opposition. They are parts of the same whole

@musingmymind Part of what #MeToo activists are pushing for is better accountability mechanisms and proportionate responses

Because when the only options are "we can't do anything" and "throw the whole man out" -- it actually makes it much harder for restorative justice to happen
